issues.title: Include planning skill in Bedrock 10.0.0
issues.description:
## Outcome

Include the accepted first instantiation of `planning` in Bedrock 10.0.0, with a traceable package identity and verified consumer routes.

Tad ratified this release inclusion on 2026-09-29 (America/New_York, native Mac date). <issue id="7fdecb55-0709-444b-8245-b427d8ad5837" href="https://linear.app/t-bone-haff-sofia/issue/HEB-178/prove-planning-assessment">HEB-178</issue> owns the accepted HEX delivery and personal host installation; this ticket owns incorporation into the shared Bedrock release. Scheduling inclusion does not assert that package qualification or release acceptance has already passed.

## Source and accepted scope

Start from <pull-request id="38722fc8-efe5-489c-a277-b2d59eecf690" href="https://linear.app/t-bone-haff-sofia/review/add-accepted-supervised-planning-skill-heb-178-92be9c31c304">Haffey-Enterprises/HEX#12</pull-request>, merge commit `c8f813149dace2d1bc7c8b62bf949e4872e33483`:

* `skills/planning/SKILL.md`: SHA-256 `d2b4891bc673f5e5374d03ac9789b801dca964be3665caa8bef5ba8b2eaf371c`
* `skills/planning/reference/provenance.md`: SHA-256 `c6e5f059e16562c43bb136a669b61e1f2a279fa1177a715eac6c40953ea73467`
* [Acceptance, adoption and retained proof](<https://github.com/Haffey-Enterprises/HEX/tree/c8f813149dace2d1bc7c8b62bf949e4872e33483/docs/evidence/heb-178>)

The adopted method is stateless, explicitly invoked, supervised advisory backlog assessment. It grants no mutation, work-start, priority-change or release authority. Tad ratified retaining the instruction unchanged and performing no further broad reasoning trial for this existing scope.

## Work and acceptance

* Incorporate the accepted skill through Bedrock's applicable authoring/admission and packaging process. Carry exact provenance and current adoption authority so historical proposed/pending labels do not misstate its accepted scope. Any substantive instruction change needs its own disposition and proportionate proof.
* Reconcile this concrete promotion with the five ratified questions recorded in <issue id="78c3d850-dff4-41d7-b003-9b885274c6b4" href="https://linear.app/t-bone-haff-sofia/issue/HEB-127/define-bedrock-reusable-component-promotion-standard-and-proving-gate">HEB-127</issue>, including product-specific assumptions, maintenance cost, ownership and HEX reconsumption. Do not silently turn that related governance ticket into a universal start blocker.
* Qualify the skill as part of the clean 10.0.0 candidate under <issue id="d2e330ea-0c71-4b0a-9005-0d397e018e61" href="https://linear.app/t-bone-haff-sofia/issue/HEB-161/bedrock-1000-bundled-major-acceptance-and-rollout-ledger">HEB-161</issue>'s existing acceptance process. Verify discovery, explicit invocation, source identity and usable consumer guidance on Codex, Claude Code and [Claude.ai](<http://Claude.ai>); retain exact host/package evidence. Personal installations alone do not satisfy release acceptance.
* Preserve <issue id="7fdecb55-0709-444b-8245-b427d8ad5837" href="https://linear.app/t-bone-haff-sofia/issue/HEB-178/prove-planning-assessment">HEB-178</issue>'s original evidence and later failures: C1 unproven coverage gaps, C2 overstated read depth/history, A1 unsupported dependency gates, and A2 unavailable historical loading evidence. The empirical floor remains one retained backlog case plus selected controls and later applications to the same broad backlog; no general reliability or unattended-use claim follows.
* Prove HEX can consume the released shared version. Reconcile the pinned personal Codex copy, managed Claude installations and any surviving trial routes without losing evidence or retaining a competing private fork.
* Record exact candidate/source identities, bounded validation results and consumer rollout in the 10.0.0 ledger. Publish and roll out only under that ledger's release authority.

## Relationships and limits

<issue id="d2e330ea-0c71-4b0a-9005-0d397e018e61" href="https://linear.app/t-bone-haff-sofia/issue/HEB-161/bedrock-1000-bundled-major-acceptance-and-rollout-ledger">HEB-161</issue> consumes this ticket's qualified package contribution before bundled release acceptance. <issue id="7fdecb55-0709-444b-8245-b427d8ad5837" href="https://linear.app/t-bone-haff-sofia/issue/HEB-178/prove-planning-assessment">HEB-178</issue> supplies the accepted component and proof; release integration does not reopen its already-ratified supervised scope or require it to wait for 10.0.0. <issue id="78c3d850-dff4-41d7-b003-9b885274c6b4" href="https://linear.app/t-bone-haff-sofia/issue/HEB-127/define-bedrock-reusable-component-promotion-standard-and-proving-gate">HEB-127</issue> is related promotion-governance context.

Full Athena construction, broader lifecycle/D12 qualification, unattended operation and parent completion remain outside this ticket. Tad is accountable for dispositions.

issues.description:
## Outcome

Produce evidence-grounded, advisory backlog assessments covering gaps, dependencies, sequence, and opportunities whose evidence could be lost by deferral.

## Scope and acceptance

* Re-fetch the relevant <issue id="e1700217-a292-43d4-8de9-1572ec70ce35" href="https://linear.app/t-bone-haff-sofia/issue/HEX-16/athena-planning-agent-and-planning-skill-backlog-groomingsequencing">HEX-16</issue> planning captures and retained manual exercises before designing more proving. Distinguish original captures from later evidence and reconcile remaining gaps.
* Declare the assessed backlog population and read depth. Resolve pagination and stale records; do not present a searched subset as an exhaustive inventory.
* Identify missing/overlapping work, honest completion dependencies, sequencing preferences, ownership, and evidence-loss risks. Distinguish observations, inferences, recommendations, and operator decisions.
* Produce a compact proposed inventory/sequence with rationale and uncertainty. Preserve Tad's disposition authority; assessment alone does not authorize mutation.
* Prove the reasoning on declared cases with retained inputs and expected judgments, explicitly stating the empirical floor and why more cases are or are not needed.

## Relationships and boundary

Related to <issue id="e1700217-a292-43d4-8de9-1572ec70ce35" href="https://linear.app/t-bone-haff-sofia/issue/HEX-16/athena-planning-agent-and-planning-skill-backlog-groomingsequencing">HEX-16</issue>; reuse its planning material while full Athena construction remains there. Pair with work-record maintenance for applying ratified changes. The Linear adapter supports source intake; manual and synthetic method work can begin immediately. Agent Code 2.0 is not a blanket blocker.

## Ownership and boundary

Tad is the accountable owner; select the execution agent when work starts. This is a direct child of <issue id="f29c1b0d-81a2-40aa-b55d-22ebc7c58690" href="https://linear.app/t-bone-haff-sofia/issue/HEB-164/build-and-prove-hex-administrative-capabilities-from-heb-163">HEB-164</issue> under the completed <issue id="5fe0a912-1de7-4522-80ed-36cd44a06945" href="https://linear.app/t-bone-haff-sofia/issue/HEB-163/hex-administrative-capabilities-inventory-high-level-design-and">HEB-163</issue> design authority. Prepare reusable building blocks before individual Agents of HEX are constructed. Agent Code 2.0 (<issue id="77679ded-0cbc-453e-8da6-5452c13378f1" href="https://linear.app/t-bone-haff-sofia/issue/HEB-154/implement-and-prove-agent-code-20-major-amendment">HEB-154</issue>) is related future-agent work, not a blanket blocker for deterministic adapters or manual proving. Do not expand this issue into durable orchestration, production recovery, or an individual agent.

## Completion standard

The declared component is consumable and its bounded proof reproducible without this conversation. Retain the source/candidate identity, cases, expected outcomes, actual evidence, limitations, and consumer instructions. A successful adapter call alone does not prove a reasoning workflow.

## Reusable form

Completion includes an evidence-backed disposition and delivery of the justified reusable form: a light instruction, an extension of an existing skill, or a proposed new skill admitted through the applicable process. A new Bedrock skill is possible, not mandatory. Record why the chosen form is sufficient and avoid duplicating existing engineering skills.

## Linked work

Completed source-intake dependency: <issue id="265a2837-f043-445e-8e72-93204f34011f" href="https://linear.app/t-bone-haff-sofia/issue/HEB-170/deliver-and-prove-the-shared-python-linear-adapter">HEB-170</issue>. Paired maintenance work: <issue id="9fac71c4-af81-48fd-8ef8-c45c93fda113" href="https://linear.app/t-bone-haff-sofia/issue/HEB-177/prove-work-record-maintenance">HEB-177</issue>. Prior planning captures and full Athena ownership: <issue id="e1700217-a292-43d4-8de9-1572ec70ce35" href="https://linear.app/t-bone-haff-sofia/issue/HEX-16/athena-planning-agent-and-planning-skill-backlog-groomingsequencing">HEX-16</issue>.

## Ratified first instantiation — 2026-09-29

Tad ratified retaining the accepted planning skill unchanged as its first instantiation, installing it in Codex, Claude Code and [Claude.ai](<http://Claude.ai>), and retiring the two temporary trial links once replacement routes are verified and the original Claude Code session releases the checkout. No further broad reasoning trial is required for the accepted supervised scope.

The dedicated skill is sufficient because it supplies a distinct stateless method for obligation, relationship and sequence assessment. It does not duplicate specialist engineering design, product discovery or record maintenance. Current adoption supersedes the historical proposed/pending labels in the unchanged candidate files.

**Delivered identity:** <pull-request id="38722fc8-efe5-489c-a277-b2d59eecf690" href="https://linear.app/t-bone-haff-sofia/review/add-accepted-supervised-planning-skill-heb-178-92be9c31c304">Haffey-Enterprises/HEX#12</pull-request>, merge `c8f813149dace2d1bc7c8b62bf949e4872e33483`. [Retained proof and adoption](<https://github.com/Haffey-Enterprises/HEX/tree/c8f813149dace2d1bc7c8b62bf949e4872e33483/docs/evidence/heb-178>).

**Installation:** pinned personal Codex copy installed at `~/.agents/skills/planning/`, with unchanged source files, adoption receipt, consumer guidance and `policy.allow_implicit_invocation: false`. It is intended for explicit `$planning` use; fresh local registry discovery now confirms it is enabled. Existing Claude Code synced/managed copies match the accepted hashes. The enabled [Claude.ai](<http://Claude.ai>) user skill v1 was directly inspected and its downloaded package matches those same files.

**Installation checks passed:** after Tad explicitly approved the read-only transfer, a fresh Claude Code 2.1.284 invocation successfully loaded `anthropic-skills:planning` from the normal synced user installation and read its complete provenance. The actual injected instruction body and provenance read match the accepted files; the changed-body control rejects. Only Skill and Read tools were enabled; no backlog assessment ran. A fresh bundled Codex `skills/list` query with `forceReload: true` reports the personal planning entry enabled at `~/.agents/skills/planning/SKILL.md`, with the OpenAI Docs entry as a positive control and no discovery errors for the queried HEX working directory.

**Installation cleanup completed — 2026-09-29:** after Tad ended the terminal session, native process inspection confirmed PID 80888 absent, with PID 1 as a positive control. No remaining Claude Code process had the trial checkout as its working directory; the unrelated Desktop process in a SOFIA worktree was left untouched. Removed only `.agents/skills/planning` and `.claude/skills/planning` from the <issue id="7fdecb55-0709-444b-8245-b427d8ad5837" href="https://linear.app/t-bone-haff-sofia/issue/HEB-178/prove-planning-assessment">HEB-178</issue> trial checkout after refreshing their exact symlink identities. Both source files and the Codex/Claude installed copies still match the accepted hashes. Route evidence is retained in `~/Documents/Haffey Enterprises/Development Archives/HEB-178/2026-09-29-invocation-verification/`; cleanup evidence is in `~/Documents/Haffey Enterprises/Development Archives/HEB-178/2026-09-29-cleanup-completion/`. Installation and its authorized link cleanup are complete. Tad authorized completion on 2026-09-29. This issue is Done for the accepted first instantiation: stateless, explicitly invoked, supervised advisory backlog assessment, delivered and installed with retained proof, consumer guidance and known limitations. No further broad reasoning trial is required for this scope. Bedrock 10.0.0 inclusion remains separately Planned under the linked release follow-up. Closure does not accept broader lifecycle or unattended guarantees, qualify full Athena, close the parent, or resolve the held C1/C2/A1 assessment recommendations.

**Evidence and limits:** the completion review reconciles the full issue contract against the retained proof. One retained backlog case and selected controls, followed by cross-host applications to the same broad backlog, do not establish general reliability. C1 coverage, C2 read-depth/history and A1 dependency misses remain recorded. Current Claude package identity does not reconstruct historical loading under A2. The original Code session's saved revision-13 readback confirms the ratified correction inserts; it does not resolve the affected substantive recommendations or establish current live-page state.

Review and receipts: `~/Documents/Haffey Enterprises/Development Archives/HEB-178/2026-09-29-completion-review/` and `~/Documents/Haffey Enterprises/Development Archives/HEB-178/2026-09-29-installation-and-tracker/`.

**Release follow-up:** <issue id="8e3dc276-60c6-4829-9f5e-7eb79c717a0d" href="https://linear.app/t-bone-haff-sofia/issue/HEB-184/include-planning-skill-in-bedrock-1000">HEB-184</issue> owns inclusion in Bedrock 10.0.0 and its package/consumer qualification. issues.title: Define Bedrock reusable-component promotion standard and proving gate
issues.description:
## Outcome

Author and ratify a separate Bedrock governance standard for evidence-driven extraction and promotion of reusable product components into the engineering commons.

This is deliberately separate from ADR-001. ADR-001 owns the product/Bedrock boundary; this issue owns the repeatable promotion decision and proving lifecycle.

## Ratified promotion test to encode

1. Has the capability worked in a real product?
2. Is another product likely to need the same capability for the same reason?
3. Can product-specific assumptions be removed cleanly?
4. Do reuse savings exceed the cost of maintaining a stable Bedrock contract?
5. Can the originating product reconsume the promoted version without retaining a private fork?

## Required design

* Select the correct reusable-standard artifact and lifecycle.
* Define proposal, proving, acceptance, rejection, deferral, amendment, and retirement states.
* Require evidence provenance from the originating product.
* Define ownership, maintenance, compatibility, versioning, and reconsumption obligations.
* Distinguish candidate mechanics from accepted Bedrock contracts.
* Prevent one successful product implementation from silently becoming shared authority.
* Define how failed or inconclusive promotion cases remain product-owned.
* Provide a bounded evaluation template without prescribing a universal orchestration runtime.

## Acceptance

* Standard is authored under the Bedrock reusable-standard lifecycle.
* Promotion test remains materially equivalent to the five ratified questions.
* Evidence and decision authority are explicit.
* At least one real candidate is evaluated without assuming promotion.
* Originating-product reconsumption and private-fork elimination are proven before acceptance.
* Standard receives its required review and operator ratification.

Do not implement or promote an orchestration kernel, DSL, control plane, or current SOFIA `agent-loop` wholesale under this issue.

issues.title: Bedrock 10.0.0 — bundled major acceptance and rollout ledger
issues.description:
## Purpose

This is the version-specific release carrier for Bedrock 10.0.0. It replaces the proposed 9.1.0 release ledger in <issue id="3d7e08d4-7299-4e4a-aeb7-9160dbde738f" href="https://linear.app/t-bone-haff-sofia/issue/HEB-152/bedrock-910-cold-acceptance-and-consumer-surface-rollout-ledger">HEB-152</issue>; that ticket is superseded, not completed acceptance.

## Release precondition

<issue id="13fe57b3-a339-4a1d-afb0-39184c315d9c" href="https://linear.app/t-bone-haff-sofia/issue/HEB-151/prevent-unaccepted-bedrock-release-candidates-from-propagating-through">HEB-151</issue> runs first against the live condition that exists now: manifest 9.1.0 on `main` while `v9.0.0` remains the newest release. Do not merge or accept 10.0.0 work first. Record whether the experiment changes candidate isolation or consumer-refresh handling.

## Included release content

Already implemented on `main`, not yet released:

* <issue id="0e67a526-1f1f-44d2-99fe-a464fced6215" href="https://linear.app/t-bone-haff-sofia/issue/RBT-112/agentsmd-is-an-untracked-copy-of-claudemd-and-has-already-diverged">RBT-112</issue> and <issue id="021b715c-3c68-4cb6-8596-35174ffc490d" href="https://linear.app/t-bone-haff-sofia/issue/RBT-123/track-codex-and-agentsmd-in-the-sofia-repo-the-codex-toolset-files-are">RBT-123</issue> Codex instruction-authority work
* <issue id="2a8485e1-58d4-4efe-825c-89b35b9a5705" href="https://linear.app/t-bone-haff-sofia/issue/HEB-145/extend-bedrockdebug-establish-that-a-reading-is-about-the-subject">HEB-145</issue> `debug` / `testing` claim-subject discrimination changes

To implement and prove:

* <issue id="77679ded-0cbc-453e-8da6-5452c13378f1" href="https://linear.app/t-bone-haff-sofia/issue/HEB-154/implement-and-prove-agent-code-20-major-amendment">HEB-154</issue> Agent Code 2.0 — major-release anchor and long pole
* <issue id="b0513b80-1e75-4bd7-8d9d-349b544d90b1" href="https://linear.app/t-bone-haff-sofia/issue/HEB-159/author-execution-relay-carry-pins-not-derivations-the-rbt-153-contract">HEB-159</issue> carried-value amendment
* <issue id="54565884-1f80-46c4-bd81-dcb412b4c7b8" href="https://linear.app/t-bone-haff-sofia/issue/HEB-153/bedrock-920-declare-codex-as-a-supported-consumer-surface">HEB-153</issue> Codex as an enumerated consumer surface
* <issue id="f787418b-3469-495e-a497-3b1ad94b2d2e" href="https://linear.app/t-bone-haff-sofia/issue/HEB-155/extend-the-fail-closed-data-hygiene-pre-commit-gate-to-every-writable">HEB-155</issue> Bedrock hook package implementation and testing
* <issue id="f14db333-947f-4cd4-9192-e9a3f97054c8" href="https://linear.app/t-bone-haff-sofia/issue/HEB-160/replace-remaining-bedrock-node-20-references-for-1000">HEB-160</issue>, the Bedrock-only Node reference corrections split from <issue id="9f0d06d1-2581-4fa8-9e5c-1c1b73855c49" href="https://linear.app/t-bone-haff-sofia/issue/HEB-125/remove-remaining-node-20-github-actions-references-in-bedrock-and">HEB-125</issue>
* <issue id="8e3dc276-60c6-4829-9f5e-7eb79c717a0d" href="https://linear.app/t-bone-haff-sofia/issue/HEB-184/include-planning-skill-in-bedrock-1000">HEB-184</issue> — include the accepted first instantiation of the planning skill in 10.0.0, with package qualification and verified Codex, Claude Code and [Claude.ai](<http://Claude.ai>) consumer routes. Inclusion ratified by Tad on 2026-09-29 (America/New_York); acceptance follows this ledger's existing gates.

## Explicit scope controls

* <issue id="b0513b80-1e75-4bd7-8d9d-349b544d90b1" href="https://linear.app/t-bone-haff-sofia/issue/HEB-159/author-execution-relay-carry-pins-not-derivations-the-rbt-153-contract">HEB-159</issue> includes the already-ratified carried-value amendment. Its new <issue id="31828fa5-2e90-43fb-8e04-8cd56af78a5f" href="https://linear.app/t-bone-haff-sofia/issue/RBT-154/data-hygiene-sweep-of-the-sofia-claudeai-project-knowledge-the">RBT-154</issue> self-attestation proposal remains unratified and must be deliberated before implementation.
* <issue id="f787418b-3469-495e-a497-3b1ad94b2d2e" href="https://linear.app/t-bone-haff-sofia/issue/HEB-155/extend-the-fail-closed-data-hygiene-pre-commit-gate-to-every-writable">HEB-155</issue> repository installation is not package acceptance. Machine runtime and repository-by-repository rollout occur after 10.0.0 acceptance.
* <issue id="9f0d06d1-2581-4fa8-9e5c-1c1b73855c49" href="https://linear.app/t-bone-haff-sofia/issue/HEB-125/remove-remaining-node-20-github-actions-references-in-bedrock-and">HEB-125</issue> remains open for its SOFIA workflow portion. No SOFIA change is authorized until <issue id="f9daf87a-e143-472a-9f33-a075cee13634" href="https://linear.app/t-bone-haff-sofia/issue/RBT-124/build-the-sofia-document-review-workbench-the-capability-itself-not">RBT-124</issue> is Done.
* The operator accepts the hook rollout delay while 10.0.0 is built and accepted, relying on the current authoring/load safeguards during the interim. That acceptance is not evidence that repositories are already gated.

## Acceptance evidence disposition

Use one evidence set for the bundled candidate:

1. prove each included implementation against its own acceptance contract;
2. prove the composed package from a clean candidate artifact, not the working tree;
3. perform version-specific cold acceptance under <issue id="f085be99-5c44-4b47-905f-f3c8889e6c01" href="https://linear.app/t-bone-haff-sofia/issue/HEB-119/wp7-acceptance-cold-verification-and-staged-release-decision">HEB-119</issue> across all enumerated consumer surfaces, including Codex after <issue id="54565884-1f80-46c4-bd81-dcb412b4c7b8" href="https://linear.app/t-bone-haff-sofia/issue/HEB-153/bedrock-920-declare-codex-as-a-supported-consumer-surface">HEB-153</issue> lands;
4. record exact package identity, source commit, validation commands, non-empty populations, and outcomes here;
5. only after explicit proceed: publish the annotated tag and GitHub release, then record consumer rollout;
6. keep <issue id="f787418b-3469-495e-a497-3b1ad94b2d2e" href="https://linear.app/t-bone-haff-sofia/issue/HEB-155/extend-the-fail-closed-data-hygiene-pre-commit-gate-to-every-writable">HEB-155</issue> open through its separate machine/runtime and repository installation sequence.

Do not claim 9.1.0 acceptance, and do not reuse <issue id="3d7e08d4-7299-4e4a-aeb7-9160dbde738f" href="https://linear.app/t-bone-haff-sofia/issue/HEB-152/bedrock-910-cold-acceptance-and-consumer-surface-rollout-ledger">HEB-152</issue>'s 17-path inventory as the 10.0.0 release population.
